overview: The Medford Board of Health approved a grease trap variance for Grounded Cafe, received updates on upcoming vaccination clinics, and introduced new health department personnel.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Grounded Cafe Grease Trap Variance Request
items.summary: The board approved a variance allowing Grounded Cafe to clean its grease trap every six months rather than quarterly, contingent on keeping the same menu and ownership.

items.title: COVID-19 and Flu Vaccination Clinics Update
items.summary: Staff updated the board on local vaccination efforts and announced a tri-community COVID-19 booster and flu clinic scheduled for November 5 at Tufts University.

items.title: Staff Introductions
items.summary: The board introduced new department staff members, including prevention coordinator Sophie Greenbaum, health equity coordinator Sophie Antoine, and special projects manager Millie.
